title: evaluator-live-registry-integration
goal: Make evaluator prefer Firestore settings/attributes/keys at runtime with safe fallback to bundled JSON; support hot-reload and observability.

registry_hot_reload.requirement: Registry changes reflected in API within 30s

safe_fallback.requirement: Safe fallback behavior with logged event when Firestore unreachable
safe_fallback.evidence: Unit tests verify fallback to bundled JSON when Firestore fails

status_endpoint.requirement: Evaluator status endpoint reports registry_source and last_refresh
status_endpoint.evidence: GET /admin/evaluator/status endpoint implemented, returns source, last_refresh, attribute_count, load_duration_ms

commands_executed.purpose: Build API package with new registry service
Populate Firestore with 69 attributes from SDK registry
Deploy API functions with live registry integration
Verify completion API with Firestore registry
Set up hot-reload test with Firestore attribute update
commands_executed.result: Test attribute created and updated, cache TTL 30s

technical_details.attribute_transformation: Firestore documents transformed to AttributeType format with legacy field support
observability_endpoints: GET /admin/evaluator/status - Returns registry source, last_refresh, attribute_count, load_duration_ms, cache_valid
technical_details.error_handling: Logs Firestore errors and falls back to bundled JSON; logs warnings for fallback usage
technical_details.metadata_tracking: Tracks source, refresh time, attribute count, load duration, and errors

verification_results.fallback_mechanism: VERIFIED - Unit tests confirm fallback to bundled JSON on Firestore failure
verification_results.hot_reload: SUCCESS - Registry updates reflected after 30s cache expiry
verification_results.api_semantics: PRESERVED - Binary segment evaluation working correctly (rulesVersion 7, 4 segments)
verification_results.observability: IMPLEMENTED - Status endpoint provides registry metadata

result_details: Live registry integration complete. Evaluator now loads from Firestore with safe fallback, supports 30s hot-reload, and provides observability via status endpoint. All acceptance criteria met. Binary segment semantics preserved. 69 attributes in Firestore. Evidence collected and saved.
next_steps: Monitor production for registry load times and cache performance
Consider adding metrics for Firestore vs bundled fallback usage
Implement admin UI for registry refresh control if needed
